item.title: Cruisin' into the Next Chapter Classic Car & Truck Show — Sat Aug 22, 10:00 AM — Yolo Branch Library
item.description:
Join us for the 9th annual Cruisin’ into the Next Chapter Classic Car & Truck Show in the town of Yolo on Saturday, August 22, 2026 from 10:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m. benefiting the Yolo Branch Library. This fun filled family day will feature an array of over 100 classic cars and trucks, antique fire engines, tractors and gas engines, delicious food, a large raffle, event and Yolo T-shirts, free balloon creations and books for children, a variety of vendors, an expanded lowrider bike show open to all ages, and new this year – the very popular TrackLab high-speed mini 4WD model car racing set up on the library lawn – free for all to enjoy.
Source: The Dirt

item.title: 21st National Juried Exhibition — Sat Aug 22, 12:00 PM — Axis Gallery
item.description: AXIS GALLERY 21st ANNUAL NATIONAL JURIED COMPETITION August 7–30, 2026 Second Saturday Reception August 8, 2026, 5–8 PM Axis Gallery presents the 21st Annual National Juried Competition, a group exhibition featuring works selected by juror Sharon Butler, founder of Two Coats of Paint. The exhibition includes works by artists from around the country in a variety of mediums. JUROR’S STATEMENT The Axis Gallery received 658 submissions to an open call, and I could have selected five exhibitions instead of one without feeling professionally compromised. Narrowing such a high- quality profusion down to a single hang was a real challenge. Whereas traditional thematic trawls tend to be self-limiting, open calls like this one afford the juror no circumscribing guidance – only that of quality on the terms artists set for themselves. item.title: Grease the Musical — Sat Aug 22, 2:00 PM — Woodland Opera House
item.description: Leather jackets and poodle skirts are taking over the Woodland Opera House stage this August as The Woodland Wellness Collective presents Grease. Set in 1959 at Rydell High, Grease follows the duck-tailed, hot-rodding Burger Palace Boys and the gum-snapping Pink Ladies as they navigate friendship, first love, peer pressure, and growing up. After a whirlwind summer romance, Danny Zuko and Sandy Dumbrowski unexpectedly reunite at school, where Danny must choose between his tough-guy image and his true feelings. Packed with unforgettable characters, energetic dance numbers, and a rock ‘n’ roll score that has captivated audiences for decades, Grease remains a timeless celebration of youth and self-discovery. Show Run: August 7-22, 2026 Week 1: Friday and Saturday at 7:30 p.m., Sunday at 2:00 p.m. Week 2: Thursday and Friday at 7:30 p.m., Saturday at 2:00 and 7:30 p.m., Sunday at 2:00 p.m. Week 3: Thursday and Friday at 7:30 p.m., Saturday at 2:00 and 7:30 p.m. Run Time: Approximately 2

item.title: DMTC's Beginner's Improv Class — Sat Aug 22, 5:30 PM — Davis Musical Theatre Co. (DMTC)
item.description: This beginner-friendly class introduces participants to the fundamentals of improv theatre in a fun, supportive, and low-pressure environment. Through ensemble activities, character exercises, and short-form improv games, participants will practice thinking on their feet, making bold creative choices, supporting their scene partners, and building confidence both on and off the stage. No previous improv or performance experience is required. Come ready to play, take creative risks, and discover what happens when you stop overthinking and say, “Yes, and!” Saturday, August 22 at 5:30PM-7:30PM Ages 18+ Instructor Information Chris Long has entertained audiences around the world for 30 years in more than 150 productions, including ballet, Shakespeare, musicals, and comedies. DMTC audiences may have recently seen him as Lord Farquaad in Shrek the Musical. item.title: Free Yoga Practice — Thu Sep 10, 6:00 PM
item.description:
Iama Embodied Community 🌀 **Move with intention. Connect with your body. Celebrate community.**
Join us every **Thursday at 6 PM** for an embodied yoga practice designed to help you release tension, ground yourself, and cultivate presence. This is a trauma-informed, all-levels class, no prior yoga experience needed. Expect a Hatha-Vinyasa flow, breathwork, and a space to listen to your body’s wisdom.
🌿 **Every last Thursday of the month, stay after class for a community potluck dinner!**
📍 **Location**: 727 T St. Sacramento CA 95811 ✨ **All our events are free. Donations are welcome.** 📩 **Questions? Reach out at** embody.iama@gmail.com 🔗 **Follow us on Instagram:** [@embody.iama](https://www.instagram.com/embody.iama)

item.title: Davis City Council Meetings — Thu Nov 19, 6:30 PM — City Hall Community Chambers
item.description:
The Davis City Council provides policy direction, establishes goals, and sets priorities for City government. City Council holds regular meetings beginning at 6:30 p.m. on Tuesdays. Most commonly, meetings are held on the first and third Tuesdays of the month, with additional meetings scheduled as needed. The City Council meeting schedule is subject to change.
The Davis City Council meets in the Community Chambers at City Hall, 23 Russell Boulevard. All regular meeting materials are posted at least 72 hours in advance and special meeting materials at least 24 hours in advance.
Visit the City Council site for information on agenda, special meetings, and more.
Source: Hate-Free Together

item.title: Davis Farmers Market — Sat Aug 22, 8:00 AM — Central Park
item.description:
Year-round at Central Park in downtown Davis, thousands gather each week to shop for what is grown, raised, and made locally at our markets. We are dedicated to bringing farmers right to your table, so we stay open rain or shine. Walk rows of stalls lined with an array of fruits and vegetables, including certified organic produce, choice meats, chicken, seafood, wine, local eggs and honey. Choose from a variety of fresh-baked goods, plants, flowers and gifts. Enjoy a picnic from one of our many food stands, made from market ingredients. See the vendor list here: https://www.davisfarmersmarket.org/our-sellers/ Farmers Market Hours Central Park: Saturdays 8a–1p (year-round), and Wednesdays 3p–6p (September through March); 4p–8p (April through August) UC Davis – North Quad: Wednesdays 10a–1:30p (fall and spring quarters) Sutter Davis Hospital: Thursdays 10a–1p (May through September) Sutter Medical Center, Sacramento: Thursdays 2:30p–5:30p
Source: The Dirt

item.title: Weekly Game Night at Blue Note — Wed Sep 9, 5:00 PM
item.description:
Yolo County Board Game Gathering Update 8/14/25: **We're still active**, but we primarily use Discord to chat and plan events. (See group description for invite link.)
We still meet every Wednesday for board games at Blue Note Brewing Company. We'll have a handful of tables reserved near the back; just look for the pile of board games.
People usually start arriving around 5pm, and games start whenever people are ready. Blue Note closes at 9pm, and although we have a 5-10 minute grace period there, you should be in the process of final scoring by 9, or else pack it up and play again another day.
Game night is open to all ages! Blue Note is a brewery, not a bar, so there's no restriction against minors. In addition to their crafted-in-house beer selection, water and sodas are available.
You're not required to buy anything in order to join us, but we do encourage you to support local businesses. Blue Note's chef team makes a mean pizza, and there are other nearby downtown restaurants
